title: N-able N-central: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 62 days old, so current versions are being attacked. Ready-made attack tools are public. The severity score is critical (10.0).

category.label: Remote support or IT management
category.why: It controls many computers at once, so one break-in can reach all of them.
category.doThis: Patch it today, or ask your IT provider if they run it for you.

summary: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 11, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
